description: Where a data folder can never be: inside a directory named in `reserved`, in any ASCII case. Each path is canonical, as `admission::resolved` (core/src/admission.rs) and `canonicalPath` (packages/cli/src/sync/admission.ts) leave it; `admission::is_reserved_directory` and `isReservedDirectory` both refuse the `refused` paths and allow the `allowed` ones. Both test suites read this file.
